tasks.title: Implement Onboarding Flow
tasks.description: Create a multi-step onboarding experience with welcome screen, feature carousel, permission requests, account prompt, and skip option using Expo Router.
tasks.details: Use Expo Router to create onboarding stack with conditional redirect based on AsyncStorage flag for first launch. Implement swipeable carousel with react-native-reanimated for smooth animations (pagination dots, swipe gestures). Include 3-4 feature highlight screens with Lottie animations for logo/performant visuals. Integrate Expo Notifications for permission screen with graceful handling. Add account creation prompt linking to auth flow. Use NativeWind for Tailwind styling. Track completion in Supabase user profile.
tasks.testStrategy: Test on iOS/Android simulators: verify first-launch only display, smooth 60fps swipes/animations, permission dialogs trigger correctly, skip button bypasses to home, completion flag persists across restarts. Check offline behavior and accessibility.

tasks.title: Build Authentication Screens
tasks.description: Develop login, signup, forgot password screens with email/password, social logins (Apple/Google), and biometric support integrated with Supabase Auth.
tasks.details: Create screens in Expo Router under /auth group. Use @supabase/supabase-js for email/password auth with validation (zod schema). Implement social providers with expo-auth-session for Apple/Google OAuth. Add react-native-keychain for biometric storage (expo-local-authentication). Handle keyboard avoidance with KeyboardAvoidingView. Include error toasts with react-hot-toast. Smooth transitions with Layout animations.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test auth hooks with MSW. E2E test full flows: successful login/signup, social redirects, forgot password email, biometric prompt/fallback. Verify error states, keyboard handling, offline queueing with supabase offline support.

tasks.title: Complete Home Tab Dashboard
tasks.description: Build home tab with welcome header, quick action cards, recent activity list, pull-to-refresh, and empty states.
tasks.details: Extend existing tab structure in Expo Router. Fetch user data/recent activity from Supabase real-time subscriptions. Use FlatList with react-native-reanimated for pull-to-refresh and smooth scrolling. Implement personalized welcome with user avatar/name. Quick action cards navigate to features. Empty state with Lottie animation for new users. Offline support via supabase offline-first queries and AsyncStorage cache.
tasks.testStrategy: Test data loading <2s, pull-to-refresh updates real-time data, offline shows cached content, navigation to details works. Snapshot test empty states and loading skeletons. Verify 60fps scroll performance.

tasks.title: Develop Settings Tab
tasks.description: Implement settings screen with profile, notifications, appearance, account, and about sections.
tasks.details: Create settings screen in tabs group. Profile: avatar upload to Supabase Storage, editable fields synced to user profile. Notifications: toggles saved to Supabase. Appearance: theme/haptics with expo-haptics and AsyncStorage. Account: password change/delete via Supabase. About: dynamic version from app.json, external links with expo-linking. Use List components with dividers.
tasks.testStrategy: Test persistence across restarts, avatar upload/download, theme switching immediate effect, delete account confirmation flow. Verify accessibility labels and VoiceOver/TalkBack navigation.

tasks.title: Integrate Purchases Tab with RevenueCat
tasks.description: Build subscription UI displaying plans, purchase flow, restore, and status using RevenueCat SDK.
tasks.details: Install @revenuecat/purchases-react-native. Create purchases tab screen. Use Purchases.getOfferings() to display plans with pricing. Implement purchase flow with Purchases.purchasePackage(). Add restore purchases button. Show current entitlement status with customerInfo. Handle upgrade/downgrade. Sync subscription status to Supabase user profile. Test mode for development.
tasks.testStrategy: Sandbox test purchases on iOS/Android TestFlight/Play Store internal. Verify restore works across devices, status updates real-time, upgrade paths. Mock RevenueCat in unit tests. Check offline status display.

tasks.title: Create Reusable UI Component Library
tasks.description: Build consistent UI components: buttons, inputs, cards, modals/bottom sheets, loading skeletons with NativeWind and dark mode support.
tasks.details: Create /components directory. Button: Pressable variants (primary/secondary/ghost) with haptic feedback (expo-haptics). Input: TextInput with validation states, labels, errors. Cards/ListItems: responsive with shadows. Modal/BottomSheet: react-native-modal or gorhom/bottom-sheet with backdrop. Skeletons: react-native-skeleton-placeholder. Ensure NativeWind dark: variants, a11y labels, TypeScript props.
tasks.testStrategy: Storybook tests for all variants/states. Visual regression snapshots. Accessibility scanner (expo-dev-client). Test haptic feedback on devices. Verify dark mode toggle.

tasks.title: Add Push Notifications Support
tasks.description: Setup Expo Notifications with permissions, token registration to Supabase, handling, and preferences sync.
tasks.details: Configure expo-notifications in app.json. Request permissions during onboarding. Register device token with Supabase on auth. Handle foreground/background notifications with setNotificationHandler. Deep linking with Expo Router. Sync preferences from settings to Supabase. Use @supabase/supabase-js realtime for preference updates.
tasks.testStrategy: Test permission flow, token generation/saving to Supabase, foreground/background display, deep links open correct screens. Verify toggle sync across devices. Test on physical devices for push delivery.
